title: Nasty Juice Fat Boy 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: If you love tropical fruit e-liquids with a twist, then you’ll adore Nasty Juice’s Fatboy 50/50. Fresh, juicy flavours of ripe Mango burst over your tastebuds with a zesty citrus bite. The experience is finished to perfection with a refreshing wave of cool, floral mint on the exhale. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
